html:
Paradise Delight Cruise – Journey Through the World Natural Heritage

Operated by Vietlook Travel – a trusted Vietnam based travel company specializing in premium tours for international travelers.

With many years of experience serving guests from around the world, Vietlook Travel is committed to delivering authentic, well curated, and seamless travel experiences across Vietnam. Our international-standard services, professional guides, and carefully selected partners ensure comfort, safety, and unforgettable journeys for every guest.

08:45 – Arrival at Tuan Chau Marina | Check-in

Guests arrive at Tuan Chau Marina, complete check-in procedures, and board Paradise Delight Cruise. Enjoy a welcome drink while relaxing in an elegant setting with soft onboard music as the journey begins.

09:15 – Cruise Departure | Breakfast Onboard

The cruise sets sail to explore the breathtaking beauty of Ha Long Bay. Breakfast is served from 09:15 – 10:15, allowing guests to admire the magnificent limestone karsts rising from emerald waters.

10:30 – Visit Titop Island

Stop at Titop Island, where guests may choose to:

  • Hike to the island’s peak for a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay
  • Or relax and swim at the pristine white-sand beach

11:30 – Explore Luon Cave

Guests experience Luon Cave by bamboo boat or kayak, gliding through a peaceful and unspoiled natural landscape.

(Guests who prefer to stay onboard may relax, enjoy music, and take in the tranquil scenery.)

12:15 – Premium Buffet Lunch

Enjoy a lavish buffet lunch featuring a wide selection of dishes, including local Ha Long specialties and refined international cuisine.

13:30 – Visit Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave

The cruise continues to Sung Sot Cave, the most famous and spectacular cave in Ha Long Bay. Marvel at the impressive formations of stalactites and stalagmites, creating a truly awe-inspiring natural masterpiece.

15:00 – Relaxation Time | Afternoon Tea & Happy Hour

Return to the cruise for leisure time:

  • Enjoy Afternoon Tea
  • Take advantage of Happy Hour (Buy 1 Get 1 Free)
  • Relax, take photos, and savor the peaceful bay atmosphere

16:30 – Disembarkation | End of Journey

Paradise Delight Cruise returns to Tuan Chau Marina. Guests disembark and conclude an unforgettable full-day Ha Long Bay cruise experience.

NOTES

  • The itinerary is subject to change without prior notice due to weather or cruising conditions
  • Wi-Fi connection may be interrupted due to geographical conditions in the bay
  • Bamboo boat or kayak services are not included and require an additional charge

INCLUSIONS

  • 7-hour Ha Long Bay cruise program
  • Welcome drink
  • Breakfast onboard
  • Premium buffet lunch
  • Afternoon Tea
  • Onboard insurance, taxes, and service charges

EXCLUSIONS

  • Hotel accommodation
  • Transportation to/from the cruise terminal
  • Beverages not mentioned in the inclusions
  • Karaoke and other entertainment services
  • Tips and personal expenses not listed above
outline: Day 1: Paradise Delight Ha Long Bay Cruise
